text:
Emma (AE): Hey team — Velos needs a short-lived hosted API key for Wednesday's exec demo. Requirements: inference-only, IP bind to their office, TTL 6h, ability to rotate mid-demo, and clear revoke steps. Can someone create and vault? @Jordan pls.
Jordan (Solutions Engineer): On it. Create under org velo-42? Confirm IPs and no embeddings/uploads.
Emma (AE): Yes velo-42. IPs: 44.55.66.77/32 and 44.55.66.78/32. No embeddings, no upload scope.
Leo (Infra): Ops constraints: max TTL 24h, set no_console_preview, add tags [poc:velos,env:demo]. Schedule auto-revoke at T+7h as safety.
Jordan (Solutions Engineer): Creating via internal API — snippet below (do not paste secret in-channel):
```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/keys \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"org_id":"velo-42","name":"velos-exec-temp","scopes":["inference:generate"],"allowed_ips":["44.55.66.77/32","44.55.66.78/32"],"ttl_hours":6,"no_console_preview":true,"tags":["poc:velos","env:demo"]}'
```
I will vault the secret in 1Password and post the link here. Revoke command (SRE/PS):
```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/keys/REPLACE_KEY_ID/revoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```
audit-bot: policy_check OK: ip_bind enforced, ttl_within_limit, no_console_preview=true
Jordan (Solutions Engineer): Key created: key_id=kr_09Txy7. Secret vaulted: https://1password.company/velos/kr_09Txy7 (access: sales@redwood,se@redwood). Auto-revoke scheduled at 2412349278 (T+7h).
Leo (Infra): Auto-revoke job scheduled; audit logging enabled. For mid-demo rotation: SE creates replacement key with short TTL (2h), SRE swaps and revokes old after validation. Please request rotation in-thread with reason.
Emma (AE): Thanks. I'll share vault link with Velos ops and confirm in-thread when demo ends.
Jordan (Solutions Engineer): Please confirm when revoked and I will remove the vault item.
Jordan (Solutions Engineer): Revoked at 2412345860 via API: key_id=kr_09Txy7 revoked_by=jordan_se reason=demo_complete. Vault item removed.
audit-bot: audit_log: action=revoke key_id=kr_09Txy7 revoked_at=2412345860 revoked_by=jordan_se reason=demo_complete"
